messages.content: Summarize the system architecture and key ADR decisions

Here is a summary of the system architecture and key Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) based on repository specifications and context.

---

### 1. System Architecture Overview

The repository focuses on building modular **Dev Container Features** and standardized **AI Developer Environments** (see [spec-002-ai-developer-environments](file:///workspaces/containers/docs/architecture/ai.md) / [docs/agents/context/](file:///workspaces/containers/docs/agents/context/)):

* **Core Purpose**: Encapsulate developer toolchains (such as Google Antigravity and GitHub Copilot) into reproducible, zero-install Dev Container features.
* **Single Source of Truth Context Architecture**: AI instructions and rules are maintained centrally under [`docs/agents/`](file:///workspaces/containers/docs/agents/) and dynamically mapped at container runtime into tool-specific target paths via lifecycle scripts (`setup-symlinks.sh`).
* **Three-Tiered Classification Model**:
  1. **Rules (Global & Passive)**: General coding standards located in [`docs/agents/AGENTS.md`](file:///workspaces/containers/docs/agents/AGENTS.md), mapped to `.agents/AGENTS.md` (Antigravity) and `.github/copilot-instructions.md` (Copilot).
  2. **Context (Path-scoped & Passive)**: Directory-specific guidance under [`docs/agents/context/*.instructions.md`](file:///workspaces/containers/docs/agents/context/) with `applyTo` glob patterns (e.g., Docker build, CI/CD).
  3. **Skills (Task-specific & Active)**: Actionable task templates and slash commands located in [`docs/agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md`](file:///workspaces/containers/docs/agents/skills/), mapped to `.agents/skills/` (Antigravity) and `.github/prompts/<name>.prompt.md` (Copilot).

---

### 2. Key Architecture Decision Records (ADRs)

| ADR ID & Title | Core Decision | Rationale & Impact |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **[ADR-001: Use Architecture Design Records](file:///workspaces/containers/docs/architecture-design-records/adr-001-use-architecture-design-records.md)** | Mandate standardized ADRs in `docs/architecture-design-records/` using a sequential numbering scheme (`adr-00X-name.md`). | Eliminates architectural drift, provides transparent historical context for both humans and AI agents, and enforces structured evaluation of tradeoffs. |
| **[ADR-002: Dev Container Features for AI Tooling](file:///workspaces/containers/docs/architecture-design-records/adr-002-dev-container-features-for-ai-tooling.md)** | Package AI CLI tools (`antigravity`, `copilot`) as OCI Dev Container Features using `devcontainer-feature.json` and `install.sh`. | Solves version drift and manual environment setup. Enables zero-install onboarding across teams with identical tooling and IDE extensions. |
| **[ADR-003: Agent Context Mapping via Dev Container Features](file:///workspaces/containers/docs/architecture-design-records/adr-003-agent-context-mapping-via-dev-container-features.md)** | Use container startup hooks (`postCreateCommand`) and cached build options (`config.env`) to symlink single-source guidelines to tool paths. | Avoids duplicate documentation across `.agents/` and `.github/`. Keeps instructions in sync while supporting opt-in paths (`rulefilePath`, `skillsPath`). |
| **[ADR-004: Three-Tiered AI Context Classification](file:///workspaces/containers/docs/architecture-design-records/adr-004-three-tiered-ai-context-classification.md)** | Explicitly separate instructions into **Rules** (workspace-wide), **Context** (path-scoped via `applyTo`), and **Skills** (interactive commands). | Prevents context window pollution in agent sessions and avoids misclassifying passive instructions as active slash commands in Copilot. |
